# Changelog

The full history is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/s00d/onlinesim-php-api/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.

## 2.1.1

- Fixed against the current API: `waitCode` no longer fails on an operation without `response`; PHPStan types of `Profile` `number`/`country`, optional `Operation` `response`, rent SMS `code` `0` for `notify` SMS, nullable free-list and payment fields.
- `waitCode` retries `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` (rate limit), `ERROR_UNDEFINED` and `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`.
- `MockOnlineSim` follows the backend more closely: rent reservation and confirmation, `setOperationRevise` and `closeRentNum` answers, missing vs wrong key — see [Testing](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-php-api/testing).

## 2.1.0

- New: `MockOnlineSim`, an offline fake of the API for your tests — see [Testing](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-php-api/testing).

## 2.0.0

A rewrite with a new API; 1.x code does not run unchanged.

- One client, `new OnlineSim(apiKey: …)`, with the sections as properties: `$client->numbers`, `$client->rent`, `$client->user`, `$client->free`.
- PHP 8.1+, ext-curl behind a small `Transport` interface, no runtime dependencies.
- The key is sent as a Bearer header, never in the URL; `lang` is sent; the base URL is configurable.
- Typed errors: `ApiError` (`errorCode`), `NoNumberError`, `TransportError`, `TimeoutError`.
- Results are arrays with PHPStan shapes instead of response classes; `tariffs($country)` is split into `tariffs()` and `tariffsOne($country)`.
- `rent->get` creates extendable rents by default (`extension: true`).
- New: `numbers->waitCode` (poll until the SMS code, then close), `user->setWebhookUrl` / `clearWebhookUrl` / `webhookLogs`, `parseWebhook`.
- Removed: the proxy API, `numbers->repeat`, `numbers->service`, `numbers->serviceNumber`, `rent->portReload`, `free->countries` / `numbers` / `messages` (use `free->list`), `init()` / `user->me()`, the response classes.


# Free numbers

## list

Countries, the numbers of the selected country and the SMS of the selected number, in one call.

```php
public function list(?int $country = null, string|int|null $number = null, ?int $page = null, ?int $count = null): array
```

| Param     | Type              | Default        | Description                                                     |
| --------- | ----------------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `country` | `?int`            | `44` (server)  | Country code; an unknown one falls back to the first available. |
| `number`  | `string|int|null` | first number   | Number **without** the country code, as the keys of `numbers`.  |
| `page`    | `?int`            | `1`            | Page of `messages`.                                             |
| `count`   | `?int`            | server default | SMS per page, 10–500.                                           |

`FreeList`:

- `countries`: `list<['country', 'country_text', 'country_original']>` (`country_text`/`country_original` may be `null`)
- `numbers`: `['country', 'country_original', 'full_number', 'data_humans', 'is_archive']` keyed by the short number (PHP turns numeric keys into `int`)
- `messages`: a paginator of `['id', 'text', 'in_number', 'my_number', 'code', 'created_at', 'data_humans']` plus `number` and `country`; `code` is `-` when no code was found

```php
$numbers = $client->free->list(country: 44)['numbers'];
$short = array_key_first($numbers);
if ($short !== null) {
    $messages = $client->free->list(country: 44, number: $short, count: 20)['messages'];
    foreach ($messages['data'] as $sms) {
        echo $sms['in_number'], ' ', $sms['code'], ' ', $sms['text'], "\n";
    }
}
```


# Numbers

An operation (`tzid`) is one ordered number. Order it with `get`/`getWithNumber`, read the SMS with `stateOne` or `waitCode`, finish it with `close` (or `ban`). Countries are phone codes (`7`, `44`, …), services are slugs (`google`, `vkcom`, …) as returned by `tariffs`.

## price

Price of one number, USD; `null` when the country has no price for the service.

```php
public function price(string $service, int $country = 7): ?float
```

| Param     | Type     | Default | Description   |
| --------- | -------- | ------- | ------------- |
| `service` | `string` | —       | Service slug. |
| `country` | `int`    | `7`     | Country code. |

```php
$usd = $client->numbers->price('google', 44);
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_NO_SERVICE`, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY`.

## get

Order a number; returns the operation id. Freezes the price on the balance.

```php
public function get(string $service, int $country = 7, array $reject = []): int
```

| Param     | Type               | Default      | Description                               |
| --------- | ------------------ | ------------ | ----------------------------------------- |
| `service` | `string`           | —            | Service slug.                             |
| `country` | `int`              | `7`          | Country code.                             |
| `reject`  | `list<string|int>` | profile list | Number prefixes to skip, e.g. `['4470']`. |

```php
$tzid = $client->numbers->get('google', 44, reject: ['4470']);
```

Errors: `NoNumberError`; `ApiError` `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`, `ERROR_NO_SERVICE`, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY`, `EXCEEDED_CONCURRENT_OPERATIONS`, `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER`.

## getWithNumber

Same as `get`, but returns the number right away.

```php
public function getWithNumber(string $service, int $country = 7, array $reject = []): array
```

Returns `NumberOrder`: `['tzid', 'number', 'country', 'time', 'service', 'title'?, 'guard_interval_remaining_seconds'?]` — `number` with `+`, `time` in seconds left.

```php
$order = $client->numbers->getWithNumber('google', 44);
echo $order['tzid'], ' ', $order['number'];
```

Errors: as `get`.

## state

All operations of the account; `[]` when there are none.

```php
public function state(bool $messageToCode = true, OrderBy $orderBy = OrderBy::Asc, bool $msgList = false): array
```

| Param           | Type      | Default        | Description                                            |
| --------------- | --------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `messageToCode` | `bool`    | `true`         | `msg` is the code only; `false` — the full SMS text.   |
| `orderBy`       | `OrderBy` | `OrderBy::Asc` | Order of operations (`OrderBy::Asc`, `OrderBy::Desc`). |
| `msgList`       | `bool`    | `false`        | `msg` is a list of all SMS (`OperationSms[]`).         |

Returns `list<Operation>`; `Operation`: `['tzid', 'response', 'number'?, 'service'?, 'country'?, 'sum'?, 'time'?, 'msg'?, 'guard_interval_remaining_seconds'?, …]`.
`response` is the state (absent when no number could be issued, so read it with `?? null`): `TZ_INPOOL` (number being assigned), `TZ_NUM_WAIT` (waiting for SMS), `TZ_NUM_ANSWER` (SMS arrived), `TZ_OVER_OK` (finished), `ERROR_NO_ITEMS` (failed). `msg` is absent until the first SMS. The server caches answers for a few seconds.

```php
use s00d\OnlineSimApi\OrderBy;

foreach ($client->numbers->state(orderBy: OrderBy::Desc) as $op) {
    echo $op['tzid'], ' ', $op['response'] ?? '-', ' ', $op['msg'] ?? '-', "\n";
}
```

## stateOne

One operation.

```php
public function stateOne(int $tzid, bool $messageToCode = true, bool $msgList = false): array
```

```php
$op = $client->numbers->stateOne($tzid);
if (($op['response'] ?? null) === 'TZ_NUM_ANSWER') {
    echo $op['msg'];
}
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS` when the operation does not exist (any more).

## waitCode

Poll the operation until a code arrives, then close it and return the code.

```php
public function waitCode(int $tzid, float $interval = 5.0, float $timeout = 600.0, bool $keepOpen = false, bool $fullMessage = false, ?string $since = null, ?callable $sleep = null, ?callable $now = null): string
```

| Param          | Type      | Default            | Description                                                                              |
| -------------- | --------- | ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `interval`     | `float`   | `5.0`              | Poll interval, seconds.                                                                  |
| `timeout`      | `float`   | `600.0`            | Give up after, seconds.                                                                  |
| `keepOpen`     | `bool`    | `false`            | Call `next($tzid)` instead of `close($tzid)`, to wait for another SMS.                   |
| `fullMessage`  | `bool`    | `false`            | Return the full SMS text instead of the code.                                            |
| `since`        | `?string` | `null`             | Ignore this value (the previous code).                                                   |
| `sleep`, `now` | callables | `usleep`, `hrtime` | `sleep(float $seconds)` and a monotonic `now(): float` in seconds; injectable for tests. |

Transient errors are retried until the timeout: `TransportError`, and `ApiError` `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` (the HTTP 429 rate limit), `ERROR_UNDEFINED` and `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`. Any other `ApiError` is thrown at once.

```php
$first = $client->numbers->waitCode($tzid, keepOpen: true);
$second = $client->numbers->waitCode($tzid, since: $first);
```

Errors: `TimeoutError`; `ApiError` with code `TZ_OVER_OK` or `ERROR_NO_ITEMS` when the operation ended without a new code; any other `ApiError` from `stateOne`/`close`/`next`.

## next

Switch the operation to its next SMS and keep it open (for services that send several SMS). Returns `true`.

```php
public function next(int $tzid): bool
```

```php
$client->numbers->next($tzid);
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_WRONG_TZID` (not an operation of your account), `ERROR_NO_TZID`.

## close

Finish the operation. An operation without SMS can be closed only after its guard interval (`guard_interval_remaining_seconds`); every attempt locks the tzid for 5 s. Returns `true`.

```php
public function close(int $tzid): bool
```

```php
$client->numbers->close($tzid);
```

Errors: `ApiError` `NO_COMPLETE_TZID`, `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`, `ERROR_WRONG_TZID`.

## ban

Finish the operation and report the number as bad. Only before any SMS arrived. Returns `true`.

```php
public function ban(int $tzid): bool
```

```php
$client->numbers->ban($tzid);
```

Errors: as `close`; `ApiError` with code `"0"` when the operation already has an SMS — nothing is changed then.

## tariffs

Services, prices and stock of every country, keyed by country code. No API key needed. The answer is large (a few MB); prefer `tariffsOne`.

```php
public function tariffs(): array
```

Returns `array<int, CountryStat>`; `CountryStat`: `['name', 'locale_name'?, 'position', 'code', 'other'?, 'new', 'enabled', 'services']`; `services` maps `service_<slug>` to `['count', 'popular', 'code', 'price', 'id', 'service', 'slug']`.

```php
$all = $client->numbers->tariffs();
echo count($all), " countries\n";
```

## tariffsOne

Services, prices and stock of one country.

```php
public function tariffsOne(int $country = 7): array
```

```php
$uk = $client->numbers->tariffsOne(44);
foreach ($uk['services'] as $s) {
    echo $s['slug'], ' ', $s['price'], ' ', $s['count'], "\n";
}
```

Errors: `ApiError` `NO_COUNTRY`.


# Rent

A rent keeps a number for `days` days. Its SMS come in `messages`, newest first.

`get` reserves the price (it shows in `zbalance`): the rent starts with `status` `0` and `checked` `false` and waits up to 20 minutes for its first SMS. The first SMS that is not a `notify` notice confirms it (`status` `1`) and charges the price; without one the rent closes and the reservation is released. Some countries (`confirm` in `tariffs`, e.g. US numbers) are confirmed and charged at once.

`RentItem`: `['tzid', 'status', 'number', 'country', 'sum', 'days', 'hours', 'time', 'time_seconds'?, 'extension', 'extend', 'messages', 'start_time', 'stop_time', 'day_extend'?, …]` —
`sum` is the cost in USD incl. extensions (a `float`; the server sends a number, or a decimal string in `state`), `time` minutes left, `time_seconds` seconds left,
`extension` `0` not extendable / `1` extendable / `2` auto-extension, `extend` maps days to the extension price (`[]` when not extendable),
`messages` is `list<RentSms>`: `['id', 'service', 'text', 'code', 'created_at']` — `code` is `''` when no code was found and the integer `0` for a `notify` SMS (a prohibited sender); it is kept as sent (`string|int`).

## get

Rent a number. The price is reserved; the first SMS charges it.

```php
public function get(int $country = 7, int $days = 1, bool $extension = true): array
```

| Param       | Type   | Default | Description                                     |
| ----------- | ------ | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `country`   | `int`  | `7`     | Country code.                                   |
| `days`      | `int`  | `1`     | One of the tariff's `days` keys.                |
| `extension` | `bool` | `true`  | `false` makes the rent non-extendable for good. |

```php
$rent = $client->rent->get(7, days: 7);
echo $rent['tzid'], ' ', $rent['number'], ' ', $rent['sum'];
```

Errors: `NoNumberError`; `ApiError` `UNDEFINED_DAYS`, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY`, `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`, `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER`.

## state

All rents of the account.

```php
public function state(): array
```

```php
foreach ($client->rent->state() as $rent) {
    echo $rent['number'], ' ', $rent['messages'][0]['code'] ?? '-', "\n";
}
```

## stateOne

One rent.

```php
public function stateOne(int $tzid): array
```

```php
$messages = $client->rent->stateOne($tzid)['messages'];
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS` for an unknown tzid.

## extend

Extend a rent by `days` days and charge the balance at once. Only confirmed rents (`status` `1` or `4`) created with `extension: true`.

```php
public function extend(int $tzid, int $days = 1): array
```

```php
$rent = $client->rent->extend($tzid, days: 3);
echo $rent['stop_time'];
```

Errors: `ApiError` `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` (unknown tzid, not confirmed yet or closed, not extendable, unknown period, a repeat within 10 s), `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`.

## close

Return the number before the period ends. A rent that is not confirmed yet (`status` `0`) and has no SMS can be closed only after 120 s; then, or with only `notify` SMS, the reservation is released. With a real SMS the rent is confirmed (charged) and closed. A confirmed rent closes without a refund. US numbers cannot be closed early. Returns `true`.

```php
public function close(int $tzid): bool
```

```php
$client->rent->close($tzid);
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS`, `NO_COMPLETE_TZID`, `NO_CLOSE_RENT_US`, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER`.

## tariffs

Rent prices of every country, keyed by country code. No API key needed.

```php
public function tariffs(): array
```

Returns `array<int, RentTariff>`; `RentTariff`: `['code', 'name', 'enabled', 'new', 'position', 'extend', 'confirm'?, 'days', 'count', 'ext_counts'?]` — `days` maps rent days to the price in USD, `count` to the numbers available.

```php
$tariffs = $client->rent->tariffs();
```

## tariffsOne

Rent prices of one country.

```php
public function tariffsOne(int $country = 7): array
```

```php
$days = $client->rent->tariffsOne(7)['days'];
echo $days[7] ?? '-'; // price of 7 days
```

Errors: `ApiError` `NO_COUNTRY` for a country without rent.


# Testing

`MockOnlineSim` is an in-process fake of the OnlineSim API that ships with the package. It is a `Transport` that answers like the real backend — same shapes, same error codes, HTTP 456 for a wrong key — and keeps a balance, operations and rents. Your code talks to a normal `OnlineSim` client, so nothing in it changes for tests. It is deterministic: no randomness, no clock, numbers and ids come from a counter.

## Setup

```php
use s00d\OnlineSimApi\Mock\MockOnlineSim;

$mock = new MockOnlineSim(balance: 10);
$client = $mock->client(); // an OnlineSim wired to the mock
```

```php
public function __construct(string $apiKey = 'mock-key', float $balance = 100, ?array $prices = null, ?array $rentTariffs = null, int $guardInterval = 0)
```

| Option          | Default                                                                                                 | Description                                                                                                                  |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `apiKey`        | `'mock-key'`                                                                                            | Key the mock accepts. `$mock->client()` uses it; `$mock->client(apiKey: 'x')` tests a wrong key, `apiKey: ''` a missing one. |
| `balance`       | `100`                                                                                                   | Starting balance, USD.                                                                                                       |
| `prices`        | `[7 => ['vkcom' => 0.5, 'telegram' => 1.2, 'google' => 0.3], 44 => ['google' => 0.2, 'vkcom' => 0.36]]` | Number prices; replaces the defaults. Also feeds `numbers->tariffs()`.                                                       |
| `rentTariffs`   | `[7 => ['days' => [1 => 1.0, 3 => 2.5, 7 => 5.0], 'extend' => 1]]`                                      | Rent prices; `'extend' => 0` makes rents of that country non-extendable.                                                     |
| `guardInterval` | `0`                                                                                                     | `> 0`: an operation without SMS, or an unconfirmed rent without any SMS, cannot be closed (`NO_COMPLETE_TZID`).              |

`$mock->client()` takes the usual [client options](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-php-api/#client-options) except `transport`: `apiKey`, `baseUrl`, `lang`, `devId`, `timeout`. To build the client yourself, pass `$mock->transport` (the mock itself) as `transport`; any `baseUrl` works:

```php
use s00d\OnlineSimApi\Mock\MockOnlineSim;
use s00d\OnlineSimApi\OnlineSim;

$mock = new MockOnlineSim();
$client = new OnlineSim(apiKey: 'mock-key', transport: $mock->transport);
```

## A full example

Order a number, let an SMS arrive while `waitCode` polls, check the code and the money. `addSmsAfter` delivers the SMS after a number of polls instead of after some time, so `waitCode` runs with `interval: 0` and the test takes milliseconds.

```php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use s00d\OnlineSimApi\Mock\MockOnlineSim;

final class ReceiveCodeTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testReceivesTheCode(): void
    {
        $mock = new MockOnlineSim(balance: 10);
        $client = $mock->client();

        $order = $client->numbers->getWithNumber('google', 44);
        self::assertSame('+44900000001', $order['number']);

        $mock->addSmsAfter($order['tzid'], 'Your Google code: 123-456', 2); // the third poll sees it
        $code = $client->numbers->waitCode($order['tzid'], interval: 0);

        self::assertSame('123456', $code);
        self::assertSame('TZ_OVER_OK', $mock->operations()[0]['status']); // waitCode closed it
        self::assertSame(9.8, $mock->balance()); // the price is spent once an SMS arrived
    }
}
```

The `msg` of an operation is the code by default: the first run of 4–8 digits, with spaces and dashes between digits removed (`123-456` → `123456`); a text without such a run comes back whole. `messageToCode: false` (or `fullMessage: true` in `waitCode`) gives the full text.

## Errors

`failNext($code)` makes the next request answer `{"response": code}` — the client turns it into `ApiError` (or `NoNumberError`) exactly as for the real server. Pass `endpoint` to fail only that endpoint. `failNextTransport()` makes the next request fail with a non-JSON HTTP 502 (`TransportError`).

```php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use s00d\OnlineSimApi\Exception\NoNumberError;
use s00d\OnlineSimApi\Exception\TransportError;
use s00d\OnlineSimApi\Mock\MockOnlineSim;

final class ErrorsTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testHandlesAMissingNumberAndANetworkHiccup(): void
    {
        $mock = new MockOnlineSim();
        $client = $mock->client();

        $mock->failNext('NO_NUMBER', endpoint: 'getNum.php');
        try {
            $client->numbers->get('google');
            self::fail('expected NoNumberError');
        } catch (NoNumberError) {
        }

        $mock->failNextTransport(status: 503);
        $this->expectException(TransportError::class);
        $client->user->balance();
    }
}
```

The state itself produces the real error codes too: `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE` when the balance is short, `NO_NUMBER` when `reject` matches the next number, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY` / `ERROR_NO_SERVICE` for unknown prices, `ERROR_WRONG_TZID` for an unknown or closed operation (`next` too; `ERROR_NO_TZID` for tzid `0`), `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY` / `UNDEFINED_DAYS` for an unknown rent country or period, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` for every refused `rent->extend`, `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS` for an unknown rent in `rent->close`, `ERROR_WRONG_KEY` for a wrong key (HTTP 456) or no key (HTTP 200).

## Inspecting requests

`$mock->requests()` lists every request received: `['method', 'path', 'query', 'body']`, `path` relative to `/api/`, `body` the decoded JSON of a POST (`null` for GET).

```php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use s00d\OnlineSimApi\Mock\MockOnlineSim;

final class RejectTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testSendsRejectAsACommaList(): void
    {
        $mock = new MockOnlineSim();
        $mock->client()->numbers->get('google', 44, reject: ['4470', '4471']);

        self::assertSame([
            ['method' => 'GET', 'path' => 'getNum.php', 'query' => ['service' => 'google', 'country' => '44', 'reject' => '4470,4471', 'lang' => 'en'], 'body' => null],
        ], $mock->requests());
    }
}
```

## Control API

| Member                                             | Description                                                                                                                              |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `client(...)`                                      | A normal `OnlineSim` wired to the mock.                                                                                                  |
| `transport`                                        | The fake `Transport` (the mock itself).                                                                                                  |
| `addSms($tzid, $text, service: null)`              | An SMS arrives now at a number operation or a rent (detected by `tzid`). Throws `InvalidArgumentException` for an unknown or closed one. |
| `addSmsAfter($tzid, $text, $polls, service: null)` | The SMS arrives after `$polls` state requests for `tzid` (`numbers->state()`/`stateOne()`, `rent->state()`/`stateOne()`).                |
| `failNext($code, endpoint: null)`                  | The next request (to `endpoint` only, e.g. `'getNum.php'`) answers `{"response": code}`.                                                 |
| `failNextTransport(status: 502, endpoint: null)`   | The next request fails with a non-JSON body and HTTP `status`.                                                                           |
| `setBalance($usd)` / `balance()`                   | Set / read the total balance, USD (it includes the part frozen by open operations, as `user->balance()` reports it).                     |
| `operations()` / `rents()`                         | Copies of the current number operations / open rents, for assertions.                                                                    |
| `requests()`                                       | Log of the requests received.                                                                                                            |
| `reset()`                                          | Back to the constructor's state.                                                                                                         |

## What the mock does

- **Numbers**: `get` freezes the price; `close` after an SMS spends it, `close` without one refunds it; `ban` after an SMS answers `"0"`, like the server. Numbers are `+<country>9000000NN`, ids count from 1. `next` switches to the following SMS. The operation's `time` stays at 1200 s — there is no clock.
- **Rent**: `get` reserves the price (`status` `0`, `checked` `false`) and keeps the `extension` flag; the first SMS that is not `notify` confirms the rent (`status` `1`) and charges it — `$mock->addSms($tzid, $text, service: 'notify')` adds a notice with `code` `0` that confirms nothing. `extend` works on a confirmed rent and charges at once. `close` releases the reservation of an unconfirmed rent and gives no refund for a confirmed one. `sum` is a number in `get`/`extend` and a decimal string on the wire of `state`, like the server. SMS appear in `messages`, newest first.
- **User**: `balance` (frozen part included), a fixed profile, `setWebhookUrl` accepts any `scheme://…` URL (`VALIDATION_ERROR` otherwise), `webhookLogs` lists the deliveries the mock *recorded* when an SMS arrived while a webhook URL was set — it makes no HTTP call; their `params` follow the real payload (`code` `''` without a code, rent `number` in digits without `+`, rent `time_left` in minutes). `paymentHistory` has no orders.
- **Free**: `free->list()` returns two fixed countries (44 first) with one number and a few SMS each.
- Not imitated: anything that needs real time — the 5 s lock after `setOperationOk` (`INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`), the 10 s lock of `rent->extend`, the 120 s before an unconfirmed rent may be closed and its 20-minute wait for the first SMS. `guardInterval > 0` stands in for "too early to close".


# User

## balance

Balance in USD.

```php
public function balance(): array
```

Returns `['balance' => float, 'zbalance' => float, 'income' => float]` (`income` only when the server sends it). `balance` includes the sum frozen by numbers and unconfirmed rents in progress (`zbalance`, which may be negative): available = `balance − max(zbalance, 0)`. `income` is the partner income. The server caches the answer for 60 s.

```php
$b = $client->user->balance();
$available = $b['balance'] - max($b['zbalance'], 0);
```

Errors: `ApiError` `ERROR_WRONG_KEY`, `ACCOUNT_BLOCKED`, `API_ACCESS_DISABLED`, `API_ACCESS_IP`.

## profile

The account profile.

```php
public function profile(): array
```

`Profile`: `['id', 'name', 'username', 'email', 'locale', 'currency', 'number_country', 'number_reject', 'webhook_url', 'api_access', 'number', 'country', …]` — `number` is `?int`, `country` `?string`.

```php
$profile = $client->user->profile();
echo $profile['email'] ?? '', ' ', $profile['webhook_url'] ?? 'no webhook';
```

## paymentHistory

Top-up orders (paginated, newest first) and the available payment methods.

```php
public function paymentHistory(int $page = 1): array
```

`PaymentHistory`: `['orders' => Paginator<PaymentOrder>, 'paylist', 'domains'?, 'forms'?, 'currency'?, 'buttons'?]`. `PaymentOrder['sum']` stays a decimal string (`"89.00"`); `currency` and `form_text` may be `null`. `paylist` maps a group id to its payment methods, or is a list when the ids are 0, 1, 2… (the server sends a JSON array then).

```php
$orders = $client->user->paymentHistory()['orders'];
echo "{$orders['total']} orders, page {$orders['current_page']}/{$orders['last_page']}\n";
```

## setWebhookUrl

Set the URL that receives SMS webhooks (see [Webhooks](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-php-api/webhooks)). Returns `true`.

```php
public function setWebhookUrl(string $url): bool
```

```php
$client->user->setWebhookUrl('https://example.com/onlinesim-hook');
```

Errors: `ApiError` `VALIDATION_ERROR` for an invalid URL; the message holds the server's field messages.

## clearWebhookUrl

Remove the webhook URL, also from operations in progress. Returns `true`.

```php
public function clearWebhookUrl(): bool
```

```php
$client->user->clearWebhookUrl();
```

## webhookLogs

Webhook delivery log, newest first, 10 per page.

```php
public function webhookLogs(int $page = 1): array
```

Returns a paginator (`current_page`, `data`, `last_page`, `total`, …) of `WebhookLog`: `['id', 'user_id', 'webhook_url', 'type', 'params', 'status', 'error', 'created_at', 'updated_at']` — `type` is `receiving_sms` or `rent_sms`, `status` is `success`, `fail` or `pending`, `params` the payload that was sent.

```php
foreach ($client->user->webhookLogs()['data'] as $log) {
    echo $log['created_at'], ' ', $log['status'], ' ', $log['error'] ?? '', "\n";
}
```


# Webhooks

Set a URL with [`$client->user->setWebhookUrl`](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-php-api/user#setwebhookurl). For each SMS the server POSTs a JSON body to it: `webhook_type` `receiving_sms` for numbers, `rent_sms` for rents. Delivery attempts are listed by [`$client->user->webhookLogs`](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-php-api/user#webhooklogs).

## parseWebhook

Parse an inbound webhook body from a JSON string or an already decoded array. A namespaced function, not a client method.

```php
function parseWebhook(string|array $payload): array
```

Lenient: numeric fields may arrive as strings, missing or malformed fields become `null`, unknown fields are dropped. It throws `OnlineSimError` only when the input is not a JSON object.

```php
use function s00d\OnlineSimApi\parseWebhook;

// webhook.php, the URL you passed to setWebhookUrl
$hook = parseWebhook((string) file_get_contents('php://input'));
if ($hook['webhook_type'] === 'receiving_sms') {
    error_log("operation {$hook['operation_id']}: code {$hook['code']}");
}
echo 'ok';
```

## Payload fields

| Field          | Type                              | Description                                                                                                                  |
| -------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `webhook_type` | `'receiving_sms'|'rent_sms'|null` | Kind of operation.                                                                                                           |
| `operation_id` | `?int`                            | `tzid` of the operation or rent.                                                                                             |
| `user_id`      | `?int`                            | Account id.                                                                                                                  |
| `country_code` | `?int`                            | Country code of the number.                                                                                                  |
| `number`       | `?string`                         | Numbers: `+` and the full number (`+79001234567`), or `hidden`. Rent: the full number in digits without `+` (`79001234567`). |
| `sender`       | `?string`                         | Sender of the SMS, e.g. `VK`.                                                                                                |
| `message`      | `?string`                         | Full SMS text.                                                                                                               |
| `code`         | `?string`                         | Code extracted from the SMS; `''` when none was found.                                                                       |
| `time_start`   | `?string`                         | Numbers: when the operation was ordered. Rent: when the SMS arrived. `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.                                  |
| `time_left`    | `?int`                            | Time left: seconds for numbers, minutes for rent.                                                                            |
